definitions.explanation: The quality of being reliable and dependable; the degree to which something can be trusted.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The reliability of this data is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}させる→向上させる：23131_koujousaseru⟧。
examples.english: To improve the reliability of products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To verify the reliability of information.

notes:
{信頼性|しんらいせい} is formed from {信頼|しんらい} (trust, reliance) + {性|せい} (nature, quality). It expresses the degree to which something or someone can be relied upon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high reliability
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low reliability
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}する→確保：13681_kakuho⟧: to ensure reliability
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}させる→向上させる：23131_koujousaseru⟧: to improve reliability
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: reliability test

USAGE:
- Technology: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい} (product reliability)
- Data: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい} (data reliability)
- Research: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信頼性|しんらいせい} (information reliability)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {信頼性|しんらいせい}: reliability (quality of being dependable)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧: trust (the act of trusting)
- ⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧: credit, credibility (more about reputation or financial trust)
